Set the total count at this+0x60 to the category-4 counter (this+0x124) plus the category-2 counter (this+0x12C).
If the existing flat array pointer at this+0x138 is non-null, tear the array down.
Iterate every existing 56-byte slot (count read from the 4-byte array header) running the per-entry cleanup stub on each.
Free the old array header block via the free wrapper.

If the allocation is non-null, store the count in the 4-byte header and zero-initialize every 56-byte slot; otherwise store 0 in this+0x138.
Run the per-slot zero-initializer over each 56-byte entry (14 dwords per slot).
Store the new array pointer in this+0x138 on success; leave it at 0 on allocation failure.
Return the result of the last slot zero-init (or 0 when the allocation failed).
